response.justification: Bogdan is a talented and versatile full-stack/software craftsman with over a decade of experience, but his profile is overwhelmingly focused on web technologies (TypeScript, Node.js, JavaScript, DLang) rather than C++. His only substantial C++ experience is a brief 6-month stint at National Instruments nearly a decade ago, and there is no evidence of message brokers, MQTT, IEC 62443, SDL practices, or industrial automation/IoT protocol experience required for this role.
strengths: Extensive overall software engineering experience (15+ years) across many domains
Demonstrated ability to work with low-latency, high-performance systems (DLang at Sociomantic)
Strong communication/mentoring skills (workshops, talks, open-source leadership)
concerns: Minimal and outdated C++ experience (~6 months, ended 2015)
No evidence of industrial cybersecurity standards (IEC 62443), SDL, or MQTT/REST IoT protocol work
Career trajectory strongly oriented toward web/full-stack rather than systems-level C++ architecture

key_factors.factor: No industrial cybersecurity (IEC 62443) or SDL experience
Strong general engineering seniority and adaptability
